days.note: Fri - US strikes dozens of IRGC targets; Iran launches another barrage at Jordan and Kuwait; Hormuz weekly traffic halves; Brent $88.00; tail 70%.
Sat - Iran attacks Kuwait; a tanker is struck near Hormuz; US threatens more strikes; Gulf mediators press for reopening; Brent $90.12; tail 70%.
Mon - Trump cancels planned Iran strikes, calls deal imminent; Oman-Iran Hormuz talks reach final stage; Brent -4.9% to $83.61; tail cut to 45%.
Tue - Iran denies full Hormuz deal, calls talks 'Oman-only' on a temporary corridor; tanker struck off Oman; Brent +0.8% to $84.28; tail raised to 47%.
Wed - Bessent says US-Iran Hormuz deal could come 'today or tomorrow'; Qatar floats de-escalation resolution; Brent -5.8% to $78.88 Tue then ~flat at $79.18; level cut to 4; tail 30%.
Fri - Hormuz traffic 33 vessels Mon-Thu vs 50 prior week, only 4 on Thu; proposed Iran-Oman passage framework faces sanctions and insurance barriers; draft bill may bar hostile ships; stress 55%.
Mon - Iran sets Hormuz terms (blockade lift, reparations, troop pullout); ADNOC tanker hit by missile, 1 dead 20 hurt this week; Kpler: 8 crossings Aug 7, down 33% d/d; tail 33%.
Tue - Trump demands Iran pay 50yr reparations, claims 100% Hormuz control; MarineTraffic: crossings fell 15->11->6 Fri-Sun; Iran-Oman agree route coordinates; tail 35%.
Wed - Latest reviewed Hormuz report still shows no signed reopening; MarineTraffic: crossings fell 15->11->6 Fri-Sun; Iran-Oman agree route coordinates; Brent $89.11; TTF 60.18; tail 35%.
Thu - Iran says Hormuz 'remains blocked', disputes Trump's '100%' control claim; Kpler shows transits averaging 13/day, near 3-month low; Brent $88.59; TTF 59.96; tail 35%.
